scope: One frozen functional fixture; three implementation/baseline deliverables, not three new sources or innovations.

direct_review.finding: Executor spans and independent original-cookie receive checker use distinct traversals; complete frame/header/order/neighbor bytes checked.

Four real memcpy spans, source retirement after completed reads, used release publication, actual FrameView return and byte verification, explicit per-cookie consumer return before B release; 16 meaningful positive/negative checks pass.

Final normal and UBSan executions succeeded. ASan+UBSan bounded run succeeded with handle_segv=0 and detect_leaks=0. Initial ASan run emitted repeated DEADLYSIGNAL and was terminated; its cause remains unknown and full stderr was not preserved. No claim of default ASan/leak-check success.
Programs exact nonbatch DEFAULT addresses/length, N_TRANS=1; checks actual NEXT IDs/DONE, full system quiet and complete payload before host-side used/consumer publication.
Read-only real backend/front-end handshake taps, held VALID checks, actual DDR R/W/B capture, byte-qualified destination bounds, and useful source-read coverage.
Test-only wrapper adds read-only handshake taps; no production hardware behavior added.
Existing behavioral DDR aligned-bus lane handling adapted for nonaligned spans; payload still comes only from real DMA WDATA/WSTRB.
Independent frozen-JSON chain traversal verifies two entire 16KiB DDR images, exact per-byte WSTRB set, source preservation/reuse, NEXT/DONE and publication-after-quiet ordering.
Explicitly reports absent real CPU/cache/native platform/board timing and mapping/unmapping costs; host consumer at one unchanged RTL cycle is not claimed free.

R2.environment: Dell host CPU; one finite execution

R3.environment: real iDMA and IOMMU RTL with behavioral DDR

next_boundary: Do not manufacture a residual with extra pressure or restart source selection. A future performance decision needs a concrete same-platform complete-cost and source-backed independent-work question; current finite functional success is not a negative result for all multi-DMA workloads.
completion_requires: Shared status, handoff, validation and final delivery records synchronized and checked before root goal complete.
